description: Describe an easing and get CSS back. Pass `easing` as a name (ease, ease-out, ease-out-cubic, ease-in-out-quart, ease-out-back and others), as `cubic-bezier(x1,y1,x2,y2)` (x values must sit between 0 and 1), or as `spring` with optional `mass`, `stiffness`, `damping`. Optional `duration_ms` (bezier only; a spring has its own settle time). Returns the CSS timing function, a CSS `linear()` version, 11 sampled points of progress against time, overshoot and settle figures for springs, and notes on feel with a convention for when to use it. The named curve values are widely shared conventions, not a standard beyond the five CSS keywords.
name: design_easing
title: Easing designer
